{{Quote|This overgrown mudball smells worse than a wet bantha! But it just may be repulsive enough to have escaped Imperial attention. And that's exactly what we need for a base.|Luke Skywalker|<ref name="sw51">[[Star Wars (1977) 51|''Star Wars'' (1977) 51]]</ref>}}
Located half-a-[[Parsec/Legends|parsec]] from [[Kharzet III]], this '''planet''' housed an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] base and [[Communications beacon/Legends|communications beacon]]. Believing it to be devoid of any Imperial presence, [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] [[Scout/Legends|scouted]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] as a potential location for a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] base. He was ultimately driven off the world by Imperial forces under the command of [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Kuhru]].
